import.disclaimer: You can save your original DinoRPG account on DinoRPG.&& &&All your dinoz, items and ingredients will be saved. The same applies to the status, skills, levels and appearances of your dinoz.&& &&Missions carried out by your dinoz will not be saved, some will be automatically completed due to their mandatory nature.&&The same applies to items equipped on your Dinoz. To start saving, save the cookie link as a new bookmark, go to the DinorRPG site and click on the new bookmark. Then paste the cookie in the appropriate field, and click on the button of the server you wish to import.&&&Accept the use of the Twinoid application when prompted.&& &&The more Dinoz you have in your account, the longer it will take to save. **Do not leave the page while importing.**&& &&You can restart the import a second time. Only one server can be saved. You won't be able to save the progress and dinoz of all servers at once, so choose carefully!&& &&If you have any questions or problems, don't hesitate to contact us on the Eternaltwin Discord.

description.port: Created by monks many years ago, Frish Port has flourished in recent years thanks to increased trade with the Atlanteid Islands. Unfortunately for you, the fish are so plentiful and easy to catch that there are no boats to take you to the nearby islands. The only ways to reach them are by learning to swim or finding a buoy.
description.market: A large open-air market where everything and anything is bought and sold. Merchants come from all corners of Dinoland to trade their goods here, so from time to time you may find a bargain! Beware, it's also the hideout of unscrupulous people who will attempt to swindle you for your gold coins.
description.papy: Grandpa Joe is an old, retired warrior, but in his younger days he travelled all over Dinoland. These days he tells his stories to any Dinoz Master willing to listen to him. Those who sit and listen to his stories are often offered missions in return.
description.forcebrut: The BrutForce Tournament is one of the most popular competitions among Dinoz tamers. Here, the most powerful Dinoz compete with each other in spectacular battles for the entertainment of the public. Thankfully, the Tournament isn't only reserved for the elite, rookie tamers can also compete here to train their Dinoz.
description.dnv: Welcome to Dinotown! This town was created by the Dinoz tamers a long time ago. After many centuries of existence, it is now the capital of Dinoland and the ideal training ground for young Dinoz masters. Don't hesitate to visit the surrounding areas before adventuring in wilder lands.
description.universite: The University of Dinotown is full of bearded professors and stern-looking, students. Although you can't understand what they're talking about, the fate of the world depends on their research - or so they say. One professor, however, is very friendly; he offers to meet with you from time to time to teach you some important lessons.
description.fountj: The Fountain of Youth has two uses. By day, it's a quiet place where Dinoz Masters, exhausted after their travels, can rest peacefully. By night, it's a haunt where love-lorn residents can let slip a few tears or a forlorn sigh. Some say that the fountain's salty waters are the pained tears of heartbroken lovers.
description.colesc: The Precipitous Hills - a mountain range in its own right. However, they are so close to the nearby \"Big All-Hot\" volcano, they seem tiny. Their slopes are still impossible to climb without the appropriate climbing gear.
description.skull: In a remote corner of the Kingdom of Dinoville sits the Lost Cemetery of Twilight. It's an extremely mysteriously place that is the center of many rumors: ghosts, strange apparitions or disappearances, deformed monsters or magic beings... over time these phenomenons have increased so that some have wondered if the cemetery could be connected to another world...
description.auree: After this point, stretches the deepest, most mysterious, and above all most dangerous forest in all of Dinoland. The greatest adventurers have died here, so be prepared before your Dinoz enters.
description.chemin: Through this immense Forest, you can see a path. It's certainly the path that is used by Dinoz tamers to go through the forest. In any case, it's better to not stray from the path as the risk of getting lost or being devoured by a Korgon is very high.
description.collin: These hills rise from the west side of the forest. They are covered by large dark trees which sometimes seem alive. Many believe that the hills move during the night when nobody is looking. What mystery are these strange hills hiding?
description.fleuve: Jumin River is the largest water feature in Dinoland. It flows through the large Grumhel Forest. Due to its width and the strength of its flow, it's impossible to cross it without advanced swimming equipment. A simple buoy won't be enough...
description.camp: This part of the Forest has been decimated by small creatures called Korgons. They are very bad-tempered and spend their time harassing the various creatures of the Forest. Luckily, this group of Korgons seems to have devoured enough wood, and are not interested in your calfs.
description.jungle: Long ago, in this part of the forest which more ressembles a Jungle, lived strange creatures. According to folklore, they looked like Ninja-Monkeys. But these creatures haven't been seen for years, to the point that most people doubt that they ever existed.
description.garde: This part of the Jungle is one of the most isolated parts of Dinoland. A few Dinoz masters have adventured here, but even fewer have returned alive. The vegetation is so dense here that it forms a veritable wall which stretches for many kilometers! The only opening is a small portal at the edge of the Blacksylva forest, but it is protected by a strange creature known as the "Forest Warden".
description.chutes: The Mutant Falls are certainly one of the greatest myths of Dinoland. Indeed, the ocean water rushes all day long in this huge hole without its level dropping. Great scientists have imagined that there is a place far away where water returns to the ocean, but no one has ever believed them.
description.baobob: Bao Bob is a strange character. He claims to be one of the representatives of an ancient population of giants that disappeared from the surface of Dinoland hundreds of years ago. His eye has seen more secrets of Dinoland than any living resident. The stories he tells are extraordinary and entertain the children a lot.
description.dome: A town under the sea! The Underwater Dome shelters the last survivors of the Atlantis civilization. In the past, they have dominated the Atlantean Islands, but a strange disease almost wiped them out. The Dome is still magnificent despite it being centuries old.
description.marais_flood: This swamp in the middle of the archipelago is a real problem for travelers! Depending on the days, it changes its state. People say it has been like this for thousands of years. Some even think that it's a giant living creature with a terrible sense of humour. Today, the swamp is completely flooded ! You can't move! You will have to wait until tomorrow to get out of this quagmire.
description.marais_fog: This swamp in the middle of the archipelago is a real problem for travelers! Depending on the days, it changes its state. People say it has been like this for thousands of years. Some even think that it's a giant living creature with a terrible sense of humour. Today, the swamp is lost in fog... You will not find any monster to fight.
description.marais: This swamp in the middle of the archipelago is a real problem for travelers! Depending on the days, it changes its state. People say it has been like this for thousands of years. Some even think that it's a giant living creature with a terrible sense of humour. The water level is low today: you can move safely.
description.corail: Large quantities of Coral have recently surfaced after having been submerged underwater for years. Coral is extremely popular in Dinoland due to its extraordinary strength. The mines employ hundreds of people.
description.ilewkk: Waïkiki is a small island which forms part of the Atlanteid archipelago. It stands out for its purple palm trees, whose long leaves are used to give bright colors to many clothes on Dinoland. Local humans also practice a very famous Martial Art, Waïkikidô.
description.chbroc: On the top of a rock on the Atlanteid Islands sits a workshop. Some say that the inventor who chose to live there did so to escape the mockery of the other citizens, but it seems to have a more specific purpose...
description.dplaza: This new area is difficult to get to, but many residents migrate here in order to flee the congestion of the capital. You can find everything there, and it has recently become a very fashionable place, where new attractions such as the Dinoz Competition are springing up.
description.villa: A villa apparently, which looks more like a holiday cottage on wheels, seemingly abandoned on the beach, bears the sign: "Warning, Disgruntled Dinoz". Maybe it's best to find another route...?
description.dcine: At the foothills of the Small Canyon, one of the Pre-dinozian caves has been converted into a magnificent Cinema. The latest films are shown here and budding filmmakers can even come here to learn how to make their own films.
description.clinik: This is the location of the newly built Dinotown Clinic, the treatment here is said to be the best in all of Dinoland.
description.chato: Once through the massive doorway, the throne room lies straight ahead of you. You see a few guards here and there, some talking about the latest fashionable game, others drying their clothes on racks, the atmosphere... relaxed. The king, always in a good mood, awaits you in the throne room.
description.poste: This guard post allows soldiers from the castle to control comings and goings from the royal domain. There is a great view of the King's castle from here. The post is extremely well guarded so it's not a good idea to annoy the soldiers, apparently their captain is merciless!
description.portal: The pentacle drawn on the ground projects a bright light which dissipates the clouds of Nimbao. Unfortunately, the beam is not powerful enough to transport you to the skies. You will have to manage on your own.
description.bslt: The Basalt Slopes are located on the sides of the Big All-Hot. These are large expanses formed of tangled volcanic rocks. A path takes shape there, winding up to the summit. Ambushes are easy and frequent here, so be careful to defend yourself well when taking this path.
description.forges: The Forges work near the top of the Big All-Hot using magma from the volcano in order to create their wares. The magma flows slowly down the side of the main streets, supplying the smiths who are working day and night crafting metallic wares, the best in Dinoland.
description.rashpk: Ashpouk is an ancient civilization located on the top of the Big All-Hot. Unfortunately a volcanic eruption has destroyed their city, and only deserted ruins remain. The locals are very superstitious and never approach the ruins, fearing the curses which are said to exist there.
description.fosslv: The Lavapit is located on top of the Big All-Hot. The view from the Lavapit is magnificent as you see the whole of Dinotown, the Atlanteid Islands, the Great Forest of Grumhel and even the white peaks of Caushemesh when the weather is particularly pleasant. In the center of the plateau stands a Shaman Temple, which has to rebuilt each time an earthquake occurs, which, seeing as its located on the top of a volcano, is a regular occurence.
description.vener: The Venerable's Lair is the most dangerous place in the Big All-Hot. In a hidden cave lives a very old Flamethrowing Dragon, who is not only bad-tempered but also hates being disturbed. Interestingly, people say that he likes little Korgons... well-grilled, seasoned with a touch of salt.
description.tunel: Near the Lavapit stands a very old tree. Its bark is so dense that even lava flows have not damaged it, which has helped it to survive many volcanic eruptions. Recently, a lava flow has cleared the entrance of a Tunnel at the bottom of the tree. This tunnel seems to burrow deep into the Big All-Hot. In order to explore it, you will need a Lantern to guide you.
description.gorges: The Deep Gorges are a narrow rock passage on the side of the Big All-Hot. After a succession of flooded valleys, the gorges open up into an immense Forest. You can see the Jumin River flowing to the south. Without doubt you can now access the Northern part of Grumhel Forest!
description.tourbt: A ginormous tower stands tall on the Great Heat. It pierces the clouds, hiding the summit from your view. The journey to the top will be long but the view is worth the detour.
description.senter: The path that crosses the Blacksylva Door leads directly to an immense steppe of burning sand stretching as far as the eye can see... Some electric arcs menacingly roar in the sky. The sand is the result of Lodestone friction, the rock which can be found in huge quantity in this region...
description.scross: The deep path that lies here, has been maintained for generations by the Rocky slaves transporting Lodestone between the Citadel in the north and Grumhel Forest. This road is now too dangerous to travel on alone. Another, safer route has been found beyond the "Sabot", to the east
description.svillg: The Outpost is a relay point for the merchants coming from Grumhel. Much safer than Nomad's Junction, this stop is the last peaceful haven before the dangers that await you in the Magnetic Steppes.
description.sking: At the center of the steppes stands a large, mysterious rock. The Citadel of the Rocky King is located inside. For generations, the royal family - half-human half-mineral - have controlled the Rockies and they exercise their autority throughout the Magnetic Steppes.
description.spylon: Located in the middle of the desert are the Pylons, a natural formation of Lodestone that continually creates the mighty electric arcs! It's better to not stay here too long, as you may be electrocuted by the Pylons.
description.slake: The quicksand here is extremely dangerous: full of Lodestone, it appears just like water. Many thirsty adventurers have fallen for this intricate trap and have been swallowed alive. People say that for each victim, the Syphon emits a melodic whistle, hence it's haunting name.
description.scanyo: Between the highlands of Toulaho lie the Trails of Toutemba, known for the many dinoz that have disappeared in the landslides of Magnetite. The ground is covered by jagged and burning stones, and the lodestone rock faces regularly generate deadly electric arcs in the middle of the road.
description.stowr1: Dinoz Masters have fought for eternity to take control of the Devourer's daily seed production. There are three Devourers in the Magnetic Steppes, but people say that they all have the same origin. Only a Great Lord will be able to capture and control the three Devourers!
description.stowr2: Dinoz Masters have fought for eternity to take control of the Devourer's daily seed production. People say that whoever gathers 100 seeds will see his wish granted. In the meantime, the seeds are resold for a very good price to the Traveling Merchant.
description.stowr3: Dinoz Masters have fought for eternity to take control of the Devourer's daily seed production. According to the legend of the Nomads, Devourers feed on the blood shed by their victims.
description.sband1: The Zaxa have always been pillagers and are highly logical, renowned for their flawless skill and errorless work. Their convoy attacks are even recognized by local tourist guides…
description.sband2: The Emmemma are pitiless mercenaries well known for their ancient ambush tactics. First, they send massive boulders into the ravine, then attack with clubs until their foes have been beaten an inch within their lives. Then they scavange. Only then do we pick up. No arguing no hassling.
description.sband3: The Mattmut are the specialists of filtering and piped-up games. Less aggressive than their neighbours, they are no less dangerous, provided you hold your gold. Their technique consists of exhausting the opponent with their traditional songs.
description.scampw: The hidden lair of the W-Team… They take refuge there in times of great danger, in order to heal their wounds and prepare their counter-attack! These nomads have a will of steel and never admit defeat. Many of their enemies have perished for having slackened their attention, believing to have struck them down for good…
description.scaush: On the fringes of the Steppes stands an impassable rocky barrier... you can see a chain of mountains in the distance, the homeland of the Santaz: the Caushemesh Mountains. Who knows what dangers and what adventures await you there, if you ever manage to get there...
description.sport: Hidden most of the time by sandstorms, an imposing gate stands in the wilderness of the steppes, at the foot of the Caushemesh Mountains. As the only point of entry into this mysterious kingdom, it prevents anyone from entering it - or would it rather be from leaving it?
description.iroche: You are on a peninsula at one end of the celestial island of Nimbao, where large rocks protrude from the ground. Some people call these the dragon's horns. Very few people come here, probably because there is nothing to do except contemplate the void...
description.ipont: The only way to cross this precipice is to cross the bridge. A violent wind is blowing, best watch your step. Due to this being the only point of entry to the rest of the island, the bridge is often guarded by Grizorg's soldiers.
description.iporte: A stone plaque states that only those who are chosen may pass through this gate.
description.icite: The city of Arboris is dug into the rock. These peaceful people live in harmony here, and each generation must contribute to the community, even though the majority of men are practically pressganged into joining Grizorg's guards.
description.ilacro: A rock protrudes from the celestial lake. The water here is pure and cool, which makes it a very popular place with the people of Arboris. Bathing, however, is strictly forbidden, much to the disappointment of most Arborians.
description.iplain: A vast white plain stretches for as far as the eye can see, snow is only found on the northern part of the island.
description.isnow2: A forest permanently covered in a blanket of snow stands in the middle of the uniform whiteness of the plains. A timeless calm envelops anyone who dares cross the forest...
description.imont: Considered by everyone as a sacred mountain, Everwest has a sharp peak which few have dared to try to climb. It became sacred during the reign of the former Archdorogon who used to come and meditate at the summit.
description.ihaut: A cavern which seems to have been dug into the summit of the holy mountain. There appears to be some kind of laboratory at the back of the cave. There are numerous vials of every colour stored inside. What kind of research was the former Archdorogon involved in up here...
description.voie: From far away, the immense observatory imposes its silhouette on the panorama that is open to all and located on Nimbao's tail. It is located on Nimbao's tail. It points its objective towards the surface, the study of stars is probably less integrated than the monitoring of the Caushemesh Mountains.
description.observ: The observatory is also a large bibliotheque that collects an impressive number of books about Dinoland's history. Unfortunately, the books are written in the language of the former Dorogons, so you cannot learn more.
description.egout: The pillar structure supporting the Archidorogon Palace incorporates a whole structure used to transport pure water into the different parts of the Dorogon city.
description.ilac: The water from the lake seems to constantly flow into the void, but the falls keep on flowing... Could it be cloud condensation that allows the island to have so much water available?
description.ilac2: Behind the lakes, there is a vast expanse in the shape of a wing, there is nothing on the horizon apart from green plains bathed in sunlight. You feel the powerful wind which clears this peaceful stratch of land, you make out the tip of the wing, very few people will have seen it from the very edge though...
description.prison: The infernal prison they call the Nimbao Hilton only opens its doors once for visitors, nobody who has entered has ever come back out. Here is where they imprisoned anyone who questioned Archdorogon Grizorg's authority.
description.ville1: The Dorogon city is rich and luxurious, The residents seem really relaxed, unlike the swarms of guards that patrol the town.
description.ville2: This part of the Dorogon city offers a spectacular view of Nimbao. An enormous pillar supports the archway leading to the Archdorogon's palace.
description.sommet: The panorama is splendid, you stand at the top of the celestial island of Nimbao. In the distance, you can see the palace of the Archidorogon, bathed in light. It represents well the hegemony of the powerful dorogone civilization.
description.palais: The Palace of the Archidorogon is the jewel of the architecture of Dorogone, an ancestral technology that uses the pure water abundant in this place. The palace is huge, and sometimes labyrinthine for neophytes...
description.mport: Monster Port is true to its name. Here you'll meet all types of monsters which live on the island. The port is configured in an odd way, it almost seems as if it's split into two separate parts.
description.mfoutp: The border between the Frutox and Vegetox kingdoms is heavily guarded. The outpost controlled by the Frutox is a strategic location from which they can spy on the Vegetox and defend the Royal Palace.
description.mfpalc: Grotox is the king of the Frutox. he is considered the most powerful Frutox among his people and he rules his kingdom with an iron fist.
description.mforst: The sacred Kaze Kami forest is renowned as being the habitat of the ancient Grotox. Ancient ruins lie at the heart of the forest which are said to contain hidden treasure...
description.mvoutp: The Vegetox outpost is hidden within a lush forest. It is occupied by the Vegetox special forces, who are trained at the Elite Camp, which includes specialists in military strategy.
description.mvpalc: True fortress, home of the king of Vegetox, the palace of Antraxov is obviously a well guarded place. Multiple guards patrol the area, an intruder would have a hard time trying to infiltrate this place. The Palace is magnificent: a huge tree sculpted with decorations that remind you of Cuzcoussian symbols.
description.mcuzco: Hidden in an isolated corner of Monster Island are the ancient ruins of the capital of the Monster Empire. Today Cuzcous is no more than a pile of rocks overgrown with plants, but the buildings that are still standing show signs of a large and powerful civilisation. Many treasures are said to lie beneath these stones...
description.mcelit: At the heart of the Vegetox kingdom lies the training camp of the Vegetox special forces: the Elite Camp. Here the best Vegetox soldiers are trained so that they can one day win the war against the Frutox. Even though the war has lasted many centuries, the soldiers desire to win the war is as strong as ever.
description.dkbao: On the other side of the portal lies an unknown yet curiously familiar place. Screams can be heard in the distance. Your Dinoz will have to stay on his guard if he wants to survive!
description.dkchut: Through the heavy fog, we hear a far away scream, some water flows violently past. It's better not to swim too far, the current is very violent....
description.dktow: A tall Black Tower stands here. At first glance it seems uninhabited, but piles of Dinoz bones lie at the entrance. The large dark door to the Tower appears half-open. It's better stay outside, entering the Tower would be suicidal!
description.dktow2: The crudely built walls all look the same, it wouldn't take much to get totally lost here. Fortunately there is only one route to the top.
description.dktow3: The long ascent continues, this inhospitable tower seems to be inhabited solely by creatures who don't seem inclined to want to leave you in peace to make your way to the top.
description.dktow4: The first dungeon in the dark tower, the entrance to which has just appeared, the dark world is constantly evolving...
description.dktowa: The second dungeon in the dark tower, the entrance to which has just appeared, the dark world is constantly evolving...
description.dktowb: The third dungeon in the dark tower, the entrance to which has just appeared, the dark world is constantly evolving...
description.dktows: The last dungeon in the dark tower, the entrance to which has just appeared, the dark world is constantly evolving...
description.fake: A deserted island, commonly known as the Isle of Damnation, where anguished souls come to die. It's particularly dark here...
description.fake2: A desert island, commonly known as the Isle o' Will-o-the-wisp, these spirits spread hopelessness and death. It's particularly dark over here...
description.rechut: Thanks to the piece of the piece of the Dark Orb you have in your possession, you can return to the surface. The overwhelming brightness blinds you for a few minutes, spending too much time in the Dark World doesn't seem to be a great idea.

description.winks: Winks have strange powers. They are rare Dinoz who can mutate, both temporarily and permanently. They have developed in time a veritable science, passed from generation to generation.
description.sirain: Sirains are masters of the Atlanteid Islands. They have good tactical knowledge and always keep cool head in battle. Due to these skills, they can expose their opponents' weaknesses.
description.castivore: Covered in thick hair, Castivorous are peaceful herbivores. Despite their small legs they are very agile and can run quite fast. They are loyal companions to their masters and don't cause any trouble, except when they shed their thick coat of fur.
description.feross: Feross are particularly rare Dinoz. Their natural habitat is the fog of the Sticky Swamp, so it's very hard to see one of them and even harder to capture one. In spite of their nice mood, their might horn is extremely dangerous to their enemies.
description.gorilloz: Gorilloz are guardians of Dinoland's large forests, especially the Grumhel Forest. Although they are strong and ferocious, they rarely show themselves unless they must protect their territory from intruders. Gorilloz are at one with nature, and behind their stern looks they are very intelligent Dinoz.
description.hippoclamp: Hippoclamps are an elite soldier of the Atlanteid Islands. Many scientists have studied them and have concluded, that they are almost certainly the result of a successful mutation experiment on Kumps made by the Winks.
description.kabuki: Natives of the Caushemesh mountains, only a few Kakubis can be found in Dinotown Kingdom. People say that a small group of them exist, living isolated on a Southern island. In any case, they are fierce fighters !
description.mahamuti: Extinct for hundreds of years, the only way to get hold of a Mahamuti is to find a frozen one. The majority of masters who are in possession of this species are often caught off guard when it finally defrosts... They are known to destroy everything in their path...
description.moueffe: Moueffes are distant cousins of Dragons, and are proud of it. They love fire, have a tough and resistant hide, plus an outstanding sense of combat.
description.nuagoz: Life sometimes appears in odd circumstances. Life appears in strange forms; Cloudoz are a perfect example of this: made from a mix of water, air and lightning, a great deal of luck is required to give them life without them evaporating instantly. If successful they become very efficient fighters and are held in high regard by Dinoz Masters.
description.pigmou: Softpigs are small animals, renowned for their ferocity and stubborness. They only understand those more powerful than themselves. For this reason they are notoriously hard to tame, but once a Master has established his authority, they will defend him without fail.
description.planaille: Glidwings are strange flying Dinoz. Their body contains many small receptors and muscles perfectly accustomed to control every inch of their wings. This enables them to manipulate and amplify wind and electricity, which they can use as powerful weapons. Although it must be said that they are not very intelligent and are easily controlled by a Master.
description.pteroz: Pteroz are flying Dinoz who soar above Big All-Hot. They have an impressive sense of territory and it's sensible to not disturb a Pteroz Mother protecting her eggs. They are quite hard to tame but excellent fighters.
description.quetzu: The Quetzu race originated on Nimbao, and since the end of the reign of Grizorg, and the isle becoming accessible to all Dinoz masters once more, it is becoming more and more common to see them around Dinoland. Their strength and agility remain unbalanced, and rarely do we find Quetzus advanced in years, when their potential is truly fulfilled.
description.rocky: Rockies are often hidden amongst the stones. They are living creatures half-animal half-mineral, their bodies are made entirely of Lodestone. This gives them the power to produce electricity at will by rubbing their bodies.
description.santaz: Santaz are from the mountains of Caushemesh. They are extremely rare and desired by Dinotown Dinoz Masters. They are difficult to tame but are very powerful and have the ability to perfectly master the Air element.
description.smog: Smog DNA was discovered by the great professor. Extracted from blood found in a leech trapped in ice, he successfully recreated the genetic code of this dinoz who was amongst the most formidable predators on the planet.
description.soufflet: Etherwasps are truly unique dinoz. After spending some time as larvae, they only really unveil their true form in adulthood, becoming a flying dinoz capable of mixing it up with the best of them! Originally from Nimbao, they are reclusive creatures, but since the troubles on the island escalated, they have started to be seen more and more.
description.toufufu: Tofufus are descended from their distant cousins, the Wistitis, and are extremely difficult to catch. They are quick and smart, and it seems as though someone has taught them kung-fu...
description.triceragnon: Recently imported from the lands of Thorgnole, the Tricerithumps is extremely sought after by the discerning dino masters. Due to their aggressive nature, it can be difficult to move these dinoz from port to port without leaving a few broken planks behind !
description.wanwan: Wanwan were once considered man's best friend, before they returned to the wild. Wanwan are vivacious, able to make multi-assaults, and their long, sharp teeth are deadly. Their fur conducts electricity, enabling them to store lightning and discharge when they choose.

npc.description: You can talk to this person.

speech.begin: Once inside the University library, you meet the famous Professor Eugene. He's well known for his interest in Dinoz Masters. He often asks you many questions in exchange for useful techniques for your Dinoz, along with other important information about Dinoland.
speech.talk: Hello young Dinoz Master. So, how is everything going? I remember when I was your age, I walked all over Dinoland! Don't hesitate to come back if you want any help or clues to any of the mysteries that intrigue you.&&On top of that, I can teach your Dinoz some very useful techniques. I can only make this offer if your Dinoz is ready. My lessons are very dangerous and can be fatal if your Dinoz is not ready.
speech.nothing: Well then, let's see. Sit your Dinoz down there... perfect. (he pulls out a small pocket light)...   Let's see your teeth. Say "Ahhhh!" ...  Mmmm ...  it seems your Dinoz is still a bit too young ... I can't teach him anything at the moment. Come back to me when your Dinoz reaches Level 5.
speech.nothing2: Let's see ...  (he examines the Dinoz...) Well, it looks like your Dinoz has really improved since the last time. However, it's not strong enough to learn the second technique... his body wouldn't support it. I think we should wait for level 6... Mmmm no, level 7 is safer.
speech.learn: So, your Dinoz wants to learn a technique? For this, your Dinoz will have to fight a monster. I will train him only if he is victorious. By the way, which technique do you want me to teach him?
speech.water: Alright. If your Dinoz wins this fight, I will teach him how to use the Buoy. With this item, your Dinoz will be able to cross short distances of water.
speech.fire: Climbing isn't an easy technique to master, you must be in possession of the Climbing Gear in order to learn it. If your Dinoz wins the battle against this monster, I'll provide some equipment and teach him the basics. Your Dinoz will then be able to climb the Big All-Hot.
speech.water_win: Well done! You were very impressive! As promised, I will give your Dinoz a buoy. Your Dinoz should now be able to access the Atlanteid Islands to the south of Dinoland. Good luck, and be careful!
speech.fire_win: Well done! You were very impressive! As promised, I will give your Dinoz the Climbing Gear. Your Dinoz should now be able to climb up the precipitous slopes of the Big All-Hot. The Monsters there are very warm, so be careful when you're climbing!
speech.learn_water: You want the Buoy? First you're going to have to fight this monster!
speech.learn_fire: Did you come to get the Climbing Gear? To get it, you'll need to fight this monster first.
speech.learn_done: I have nothing else to teach to your Dinoz. But don't worry, there are people throughout Dinoland who will teach it new techniques!
speech.question: Ah, I l-o-v-e questions ! What do you want to know, young tamer?
speech.dinoville: The Dinotown Kingdom has been destroyed and rebuilt many times during ancient times. Today, it's a civilized and developing place, compared with it's wild surroundings. That's the reason why Dinotown is a perfect place for a young Dinoz Master such as yourself!&& Make sure to train your Dinoz well before venturing to other regions of Dinoland as the monsters are far more dangerous!
speech.atlante: A long time ago, there was an island to the south of Dinoland called Jazz island.&& Jazz Island was blasted into the air by an underwater eruption and landed on the plateau of a volcanic peak 100 meters in the air. However, little by little the peak was eroded by the waves until Jazz Island crashed into the ocean, causing a massive tsunami that wiped out a half of Dinoland and destroyed most of the ancient human civilizations in the process.&& Today, after many centuries, things are starting to get back to normal, but a large part of Dinoland is still wild and dangerous. Anyway, the Atlanteid Islands are fragments of Jazz Island.&& People say that only Sticky Swamp remains in it's natural state.
speech.gtc: Hey young Dinoz Master, do you see that small triangle up there? It's actually a huge volcano called the Big All-Hot. I advise you to go there, you can eat some really tasty merguez, they're always perfectly grilled.&& When I was younger, I studied the ruins of ancient civilizations. Did you know that thousands of years ago on the top of the Big All-Hot, there was an entire civilization called Ashpouk? And one day, boom! The volcano erupted and the entire civilization was destroyed! Sad isn't it?&& In any case, I advice you to go excavate the ruins. You might find some ancient relics there, and don't forget to taste the merguez.
speech.gant: The Zors Glove is a very rare item! People say that the Zors Glove must be used at the Mutant Falls to access to Grumhel Forest, but no one knows how to use it.
speech.stone: Ohhhhhhh !!! But here is something very interesting, it seems to me that it is.... uhmmuhu.... i'm not sure... (he stares at the stone)... Can you show me this Stone, that I examine it a little?
speech.stone_yes: Ooooooohhhhh!!! Yes ... It's exactly what I thought ... Look! (he delicately cleans the stone) ... it's an Ashpouk Totem! It's very valuable ... take care of it!
speech.noquestion: Ah well, too bad, don't hesitate to come back from time to time to find out more about the world of Dinoland!
speech.pac_start: Ahh, very good question from a young and passionate student. It is a scroll where I compile my research on the Dinoz that surround us. Did you know they can learn different aptitudes and that each of those allows them to unlock more potential? Like a system with drawers within drawers. I decided it to call it a furniture of skills.&&Anyway, I've put my notes in there and it's coming in very handy. But I don't want someone to steal my research that's why I'm using special ink and paper of shamanic and scientific craft that allow only my own eyes to decipher what I write.
speech.pac_go: Are you crazy!?!?!?!?!?!&& &&Get the hell out of here and don't ever mention again this scroll to me!
speech.pac_scroll: Ah, well... Congratulations!... You created this marvel all by yourself too... I suppose you need help to figure out how to use it?&& && &&Come back when you will have more experience raising Dinoz.
speech.pac_end: Well well well. Here's the Scroll of Compiled Abilities.&& &&It's very easy to use, when your Dinoz have learned a skill a certain number of times, this skill will be visible in the skill tree. *Yes, I did end up going for tree instead of root...*

playerChoice.question: Ask a question
playerChoice.stone_no: Hey! Don't touch it! Before, I would like to know something...
playerChoice.pac_scroll: Show the scroll, the ink and the quill

speech.begin: Stretched out on Mandragore's deckchair, Sofia is sipping a cocktail. She is clearly enjoying the sunshine and tanning on the beach...
speech.nouvelle: Sluuuuuuuurpp.... It's not too bad, It was pretty quiet before you arrived. Why don't you play somewhere else? Slurpp.... And don't bother my husband, I wouldn't want you giving him any suspicious ideas...
speech.bien: It's best to leave her alone, if even Mandragore doesn't dare to upset her, then who would be foolish enough to do so...?
speech.troph: Slurpp.... Caushemesh fears nothing... I've put the girls in charge of guarding the breach in the Dark World. If there's a problem, I'll send my husband to do my job.
speech.palais: There's nothing interesting there anyway... Except maybe for one object. Hmm... I really don't feel like going to get it... Look, I'll give it to you, I don't need it anyway, now that I've got the real one, hehe... Take it as a reward for finding my husband.
speech.retour: Now leave me, I have urgent business to deal with... ... Mandrachou !!!! Come and massage me... FAST !
speech.niveau: It's true that with your current level, you're not going to get very far... Well, I'm capable of breaking the maximum level limit of your dinoz, but beware, this decision is IRREVOCABLE! Once I've broken the limit, you'll be able to go all the way up to level 60!
speech.yes:
So be it ! _(Sofia suddenly gets up, concentrates her energy... and throws an intense shock on your dinoz!)_
_(Through the pain, you can see a transformation taking place. It's developing a new strength, capable of overcoming the harsh trials that lie ahead!)_ Well, I've lifted the seal that was preventing your dinoz from evolving. This seal was put in place a long time ago to prevent the overpopulation of such powerful dinoz... (Your dinoz has changed, it can now go beyond its limits, how will it evolve? )_
speech.ether: Well, it would probably die from it... However, if it's exposed to the ether for a short time, it could learn new skills which should make it much stronger! Be aware though, after this is done, the dinoz will no longer be able to access the old skills trees so you will not be able to go back and learn any missing skills further down the line... before you expose your dinoz to the ether, make sure you have optimized your dinoz skills...
speech.newskill:
So be it ! _(Sofia takes a tank filled with ether, and plunges your dino into it at once !)_
		_(Not happy to be handled that way, your dino soon comes out sulking...)_
		Now, your dinoz will gradually understand the significance of this act as it gains extra levels. _(You look questioningly at your dinoz, whose pupils are greener than before. What does he have in charge for you?)_
speech.no: Well, if you change your mind, you can come see me again. You can also come to me with any of your dinoz that have reached level 50.

speech.ether: After centuries of research, the Caushemeshians have mastered the power of Ether, a complex mix of the Air and Void elements. It's an extraordinary technological advancement, all thanks to Caushemesh engineers, the best in Dinoland!
speech.next: Your Dinoz are too weak. They're no match for ours, hahahaha! Make sure you train your Dinoz well, as the day will come when you are called upon to fight more powerful enemies!
speech.more: Enough of me talking... what would you say about a little mission to convince you of the strength of our technology?
speech.begin_3: I thought I should let you know that all the Dark Dinoz you have met up until now were only newbies that we train in this region of Dinoland... the Dinoz of Caushemesh are far stronger. Even your Venerable will be no match for our strongest Dinoz masters!
speech.next_2: I'm a man of my word. Here's a reward to convince you of the superiority of Caushemesh technology. I only have one copy, so use it well... it's a bracelet made of Tik, you can equip it on any Dinoz of your choice.

playerChoice.go: This guy seems dangerous... it's probably a good idea to move away from him.
playerChoice.qual2: It's probably a bad quality cape
playerChoice.qual: It's probably a bad quality cape

speech.begin: A recent earthquake has cracked the rock face. An ice-cold wind blows in your direction and you notice a strange man standing nearby, inspecting the crack.
speech.talk: Pheewww!! Did you see the crack? It opens into an enormous cavern, it's ice cold inside! Hey! Be careful! If your Dinoz enters the cavern he'll be frozen immediately!
speech.gla: You see!! It's cold around... According to my thermodynamic studies, the hot magma flows from the Big All-Hot and the heat is absorbed from the supra conductive rocks. This creates a strange cooling effect through convection. In effect, it's a natural fridge inside!
speech.ok: Isn't it!? I often explore the caverns and other strange underground lairs. That's my job, I'm a spelelelologist! I got my degree in Speleology from Dinotown University!
speech.ok2: Thank you, you're very kind. I came here immediately after I heard about the earthquake. It seems I was the first person to discover this cave! I've already given it a name: The Relative Zero Cave! What do you think?
speech.ok3: Thanks! As you've been so nice to me, I'll give you a little tip. If you put your Dinoz in the Relative Zero Cave, he'll be frozen...
speech.congel: Yup! Fro-zen! But the good thing is that the temperature is not so low that it will kill him. It will only freeze him temporarily! You won't be able to use this Dinoz anymore. But he will not count in your Dinoz LIMIT. So you can have MORE Dinoz! But you'll have to keep an eye on the side effects.
speech.congel2: Yes, from the moment your Dinoz is frozen, he does not count towards your LIMIT. You can only defrost him if you are under the LIMIT, this means that you will have to freeze another Dinoz so that the other Dinoz can take his place... your Dinoz will take one full day to defrost, you will need to be very patient... do you understand?
speech.thanks: You're welcome! Don't hesitate to call me if you need any help exploring any mysterious underground lairs!
speech.bye: Ciao! And make sure you don't come too close to this crack!

speech.begin: You come across a strange and menacing Dinoz. He's staring at you intensely with his red eyes, he seems to be very angry!
speech.fight_win: You've defeated a Pteroz and earned the Pteroz Trophy. This allows you to buy a Pteroz in the Dinoz Shop. Congratulations!
speech.leave: Phewww! One more step and this Dinoz would have attacked you!

speech.begin: You come across a strange Dinoz. As it spots you, it turns and starts to run directly at you. What do you do?
speech.fight_win: You've defeated a Hippoclamp and earned the Hippoclamps Trophy. This allows you to buy a Hippoclamp in the Dinoz Shop. Congratulations!
speech.leave: It seems he isn't chasing you anymore ... but what kind of Dinoz could it be?

speech.begin: A strange stone is standing in your way. It seems like a very odd location for a stone... What do you want to do?
speech.fight_win: Oops!! It seems that this stone was in fact a Rocky, a half-animal/half-mineral Dinoz rarely found in Dinoland... By defeating it, you've earned the Rockies Trophy, which allows you to buy a Rocky in the Dinoz Shop. Congratulations!
speech.touch: That's strange... this stone seems to be warm but nothing else. Maybe it's better to keep on going....
speech.leave: You're right, it's only a rock...

speech.begin: GWWWWWWWWAAAAAAARGGGGGGGHHHHHH !!!! Whoooooo dares to waaaake me up from my naaaape?
speech.bye: You're right, there are times in life when it's better to leave quickly and quietly rather than being brave...
speech.moi: What do you want!? I hope you have a good reason for being here, or else I'll COOK your Dinoz and have them for BREAKFAST!!!
speech.korgon: A KORGON, you say??? Where? I'm hungry, bring him to me!
speech.next1: Argh! He got away? That's so IRRITATING! Don't worry, I can sympathize. In my youth, I often let breakfast escape from me like that. Now I cook them immediately, so they don't have time to escape!
speech.fight_win: GROOOOAAARRH!!! You may have won THIS time! BUT we WILL meet again!
speech.moi2: I remember your Dinoz. What do you want again?
speech.question: So, Korgon eater, can I GRILL something for you? Or maybe I can do you another favor? Don't ask for too much, or else I'll CUT you into small crispy pieces. It would be perfect for my BREAKFAST!!!
speech.force: Stronger you say? Well then, you should follow my advice, go and see the SHAMAN at Lavapit, he'll help you GRILL your enemies!
speech.fight2: I'm really hungry at the moment, would you mind if I did it later?

playerChoice.korgon: I was running after a Korgon and...
playerChoice.question: Shout waaah...
playerChoice.force: I'd like my Dinoz to be stronger first!
playerChoice.perdu: I got lost coming here and...
playerChoice.chasse: I'm a Great Dorogon Hunter. I've come here to challenge you!
playerChoice.deal: I have a GOLDEN business opportunity for you!

speech.begin: . . . . . me . . . lost . . . . . without power . . stars . . . . never . . . . be able to go .... home . . . . help me?
speech.no: It's better not to get involved with people who look like that!
speech.yes: . . . . . Thanks  . . . . a lot . . . Bziiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiit! Ah! Finally! My simultaneous translator is fixed! Luckily I had some spare strawberry batteries! Thanks for offering your help my friend!
speech.nothing: But it's all thanks to you! As I just told you, I have a little technicological problem. My (SiAvUaEs) is completely broken, and I can't go back to (PuOsEniLa)!
speech.dom: I need your help to recover some crystals from (TcEtCiNo)... Let me think... How can I describe them in your language? They look like shining stars!
speech.star: Yes! If you bring me exactly seven stars. I'll be able to finish my journey, and maybe reward you with a (CiLoJuAeDa) from my planet!
speech.how: It's relatively easy. All you have to do is complete missions which are listed in the Eclectik Tourist Guide. Each time I read out a mission description, you'll have to complete it!
speech.ah: Hmmmm... well! I'm going to get the Tourist Guide. Wait here, I'll be back in a minute....
speech.begin_first_star: The Guide says: "A megawolf is waiting you in the capital!"
speech.et: And? That's all! You'll have to carry this mission out alone. Sorry to be so eclectic!
speech.begin_star: Ah! I see that you're progressing with your quest! Let see what the Tourist Guide says next...
speech.star2: The guide says: "The enthusiastic greasy man would appreciate a transported cloud"... does that mean anything to you?
speech.star3: Tourist Guide, page 879 indent B: "When you get stuck up to the neck, nothing is better than a nice cake". Does that mean anything to you?
speech.star4: The guide says: "The shady hole call will serve you"... Do you have any ideas??
speech.star5: The next one is written in small text. It says: "The old bones like to watch a... capsicum", yup... that's all it says... (I think)
speech.star6: Appendix B of the Tourist Guide: "Visit the god-man at noon at Pek-1". Mmmmmmm....
speech.star7: The last missing star! The Guide says: "At the country of Saru, you will return from the dead without firework". Sounds dangerous!
speech.end: Your language is a bit strange... I can't make sense of it!
speech.begin_plume: .... Yeaaaahh!!! Thanks a lot! I'll finally be able to return to (PuOsEniLa)! I have to hurry though, as the stars are aligning in the Rochechouart.
speech.ok: Can you give me the stars. I'll give you a (CiLoJuAeDa) in exchange, plus a trinket I found in Dinoland!
speech.give: The Strange Being runs to some kind of small house, then a big lightning strikes before the house disappears. All that remains are burned traces on the ground and a column of smoke rising far up into the sky... He left you one "Gold Napodino" and a strange collectible item...

speech.uhm: Je te raconte tout ça ! oh oh oh ! Mais ca n'a aucune importance, car de toute façon j'ai une bonnédiction qui te fera rapidement tout oublier de moi !
speech.bonne: Oui, oh ! oh oh oh ! C'est comme une malédiction mais en mieux ! je suis protégée par une bonnédiction pour éviter que les gens fassent des cauchemars et pour éloigner les scientifiques. Ils seraient trop ravis d'examiner la façon dont je me nourris,  oh oh oh ! Je ne fais même plus attention à mon cholestérol. Bref, peu aprés m'avoir vu, les gens m'oublient aussitôt !
speech.next: N'est-ce pas !!! Du coup, comme je ne peux pas m'éloigner d'ici, comment veux-tu que je le retrouve ! Mon Mouldeur CHERI !!!
speech.nohelp: Tu ne peux m'aider de toute façon... oh oh oh ! Laisse moi seule maintenant, je vais penser à lui, et n'oublie pas de m'oublier...
speech.forgot: Il vous a semblé un instant que vous parliez avec quelqu'un, mais vous n'arrivez pas à vous en rappeller les détails...
speech.help: VRAIIMMMEENTTT ?? OH OH OH OH OH !! Tu ferais ça pour moooaa ?!! Mais ca va être difficile pour toi, et à chacune de nos rencontres tu ne te souviendras de rien ou presque ! Es-tu vraiment certain de vouloir m'aider ???
speech.accept: OH OH OH OH OH !! Alors, s'il te plait Monsieur le Maître Dinoz ! Aide-moi à retrouver Moulder et je te récompenserai comme il se doit !!
speech.missions: L'effrayante squelette vous regarde partir l'air déçue. Si vous vous retourniez vous pourriez presque la voir pleurer, mais vous continuez à courir le plus loin possible, et vous avez sûrement raison.
speech.you: C'est exact, enchanté ! Saviez-vous que dans ces ruines on peut trouver d'étranges cercles brulés ? J'étudie ces phénomènes depuis longtemps, et je suis arrivé à la conclusion qu'il existe deux explications quand à ces étranges marques...
speech.explain: Tout laisse à penser qu'il pourrait s'agir de créatures étranges venues de l'espace et qui, en venant étudier les humains, se posent dans des endroits discrets... Comme elles crachent le feu, elles laisseraient ces étranges cercles de brulé en repartant vers leur planète natale ! Et bien entendu, le Roi cache ces informations car il conspire avec elles ! Extraordinaire non ?
speech.other: Ah ? ... uhm... L'autre explication me semble beaucoup moins plausible, mais d'après le vendeur de merguez, il s'agirait des traces de feu de camp laissées par les touristes visitant les ruines...
speech.ok: Uhm ! Succulentes ces Crevettes au Napalm ! Et dire que je ne reverrai jamais ma charmante femme ! Oh combien nous nous aimions... les petits cris qu'elle poussait quand je revenais d'un apéro bien arrosé avec mes collègues me manquent... Et dire qu'elle est certainement morte...
speech.ok2: Quoi ? Nous mais vous rigolez j'espère. Je suis encore dans ma prime jeunesse ! Regardez comme mes os sont lisses : pas une ride ! Ah ah ah ah ah !
speech.exp: ............. Merci ! Cela veut dire que mon intuition ne me trompais pas et que j'ai bien fait de ne jamais chercher une autre femme pour la remplacer ! Oooohh ! Merci ! Mille fois merci de nous avoir aidé !
speech.end: Si ! C'est un véritable exploit !!! Accompagnez-moi jusqu'à ma femme je vous en prie, il me tarde tellement de pouvoir la contempler yeux-dans-les-yeux !!
speech.bye: L'effrayante squelette vous regarde partir l'air déçue. Si vous vous retourniez vous pourriez presque la voir pleurer, mais vous continuez à courir le plus loin possible, et vous avez sûrement raison.
speech.begin_memory: oh oh Oh Oh OH !! La bonnédiction est levée ! Tu vas maintenant pouvoir m'aider à trouver Mouldeur !
speech.begin_pda: Merci pour ce que tu as fait pour nous ! Mouldeur et moi vivons désormais notre amour dans ce magnifique cadre avec vue sur la mer ! Quel bonheur de le savoir à mes côtés chaque jour !
speech.pda: Oh mais si ! Tu as fait beaucoup ! Tiens voilà pour toi... je t'offre ce magnifique Planificateur qui t'aidera dans ta quête à gérer tes différents Dinoz. Il sera rajouté à tes objets de collection, alors prends-en bien soin !
speech.dinoz: Oh mais si ! Tu as fait beaucoup ! Reviens me voir quand tu auras plus de Dinoz, et je te donnerai un cadeau qui t'aidera dans ta quête !
speech.begin_star: Oh oh oh oh oh oh oh oh oh oh oh oh oh oh !! Mais que vois-je là !!! N'est-ce pas un magnifique exemplaire de "Capsicum annuum" ! Quelle couleur, quelle odeur, c'est ma-gni-fi-que !
speech.ok_star: Je te remercie vraiment ! oh oh oh ! En échange pour m'avoir offert cette vision splendide, je vais te donner un truc que j'ai trouvé en cherchant un os que j'avais perdu ! Tiens !
speech.star: Félicitations ! Grâce à Skully, vous avez récupéré la 5ème étoile magique ! Plus que deux !

speech.yes: Malheureusement, comme le précise le règlement intérieur, paragraphe 15.48 alinéa H, l'accès au Tournoi est ouvert uniquement aux Dinoz ayant en leur possession une relique d'une civilisation ancienne. item.title: Merchant:

flying.name: Dinoland Flying Shop
flying.description: The Dinoland Flying Shop is always accessible. Just whistle (loudly - the shop can be a little hard of hearing) and the store will arrive, allowing you to purchase a variety of basic items. As you explore Dinoland, you'll come across other Shops in Dinoland with more interesting items.

forge.name: Forges Shop
forge.description: The Forges are where items made from the fire of the Big All-Hot are also sold. You can find lots of useful items for battle there.

magic.name: Magic Shop
magic.description: Hidden away in a small Dinotown street, adventurers sometimes get lost and thus find the Magic Shop. Only extremely rare and powerful items are sold here. They can't be bought with common or garden gold coins. Furthermore, these items are enchanted: once equipped by a Dinoz, they can't be removed for several days!

cursed.name: Cursed Shop
cursed.description: The Cursed Shop sells rare items that cannot be found elsewhere. As it is said that whoever enters it is cursed for life, only those who are already cursed dare to venture there...

fruity.name: Fruit Shop
fruity.description: "If you leave gold in the bucket hanging from the old tree, a fruit will fall!"! »

razad.name: At Razad
razad.description: Razad is an old nomad who fled the western steppes, which had become too dangerous for his business. Today, its store is much more modest than before, but at least it is secured at the Rocky's Outpost.

souk.name: Souk "Lightning Sales"
souk.description: The souk is located a little away from the Magnetite Pylons, offering a very nice view of the electric arcs that regularly form in this region. Unfortunately, the shop is not beyond the reach of these arcs, which poses some obvious problems...

neerhel.name: Provider of Toutemba
neerhel.description: Le Pourvoyeur's little shop is hidden deep in the canyons of Toutemba in a well-protected cove. Normal when you know the dangers of the region...

barbarian.name: Barbarian barter
barbarian.description: “Price not negotiable. You not touch goods. PAS TOUCHER J'AI DIT ! If you touch, me CRUSH you!”

secret.name: Secret Store
secret.description: " Team-W's secret store contains all the Magnetic Steppes items in one place, and above all at very reasonable prices! "

elit.name: Elit Shop
elit.description: You will find in this shop various objects that the Vegetox special forces often use during their dangerous missions.

chens.name: Chen's Shop
chens.description: Chen provides you with consumable skills, they are so powerful that they destroy themselves after use. They are to be used sparingly.

merchant.name: Travelling Merchant
merchant.description: The Traveling Merchant walks through all of Dinoland and buys the Ingredients from the Dinoz Masters: he offers a lot of gold!
merchant.dimanche: The Traveling Merchant has taken his day off, wait until tomorrow to be able to sell your ingredients again. Of course, the Traveling Merchant will have moved to a different place, so it will be necessary to find him before you can sell your ingredients.

filou.name: Shadowy Man
filou.description: It's pretty expensive, but on the face of it, there is no other way to obtain it easily...

description.fish: Madame Seyche, a resident of Dinoville, is looking for fresh fish to organize a dinner with her friends. Can you get her some fish from the Merchant in Port of Prêche in the south? He has been warned and he is waiting for you.
description.dog: The old lady Ducraft lost her poodle while visiting her son in the Precipitous Hills, can you find him?
description.kilgou: Wolves and Smashrooms are invading the Precipitous Hills, north of Dinotown. The chief of a neighboring village is looking for someone to kill a few of them in order to scare them off and restore natural order. Do you think you are strong enough to accept this mission?
description.kilwlf: Recently, farmers have had a lot of problems with groups of wolves attacking their goats. Peux-tu faire un tour ici et là et en tuer quelques-uns histoire de les éloigner ?
description.fflow: Madam Squyd's favorite rose bush is in a bad state following the heat wave. Can you go to the Fountain and get some Pure Water to bring to her?
description.kbook: I've received another request from the pretty Madam Squyd. She wants to check a recipe in a book from the University. Can you take it to her?
description.msg: I want to write a letter to someone who is close to my heart, but my stamps have been stolen by some thieving Smashrooms at the Fountain of Youth. If you kill them, I'll let you use my stamps, have we got a deal?
description.lettre: Uhm, this time it's for me, Grandpa Joe, that you will work for... I need your help to deliver an URGENT letter to someone special in Dinotown. It's urgent, it must be delivered as soon as possible!
description.kilglu: A Strange monster has recently appeared in the Dinotown Kingdom. Apparently it's very tough and can take a lot of damage during a battle. Can you kill one and bring it back to me so I can study it?
description.kilgnt: I'm not sure if you've noticed but the Dinotown Kingdom has recently been invaded by huge Green Giants, and they don't just eat vegetables if you catch my drift! I need you to exterminate a dozen of them as quickly as possible! The order has come straight from the King, so we have to hurry!
description.kilcoq: I've planned another Golf party with the King next month, and he wants to hear more about your exploits .... what do you think about killing some Giant Chickens for me this time? As per usual, you will be richly rewarded!
description.kilpir: It's Sophie from Waikiki Island's birthday soon. Her favorite meal is made from Pirhanoz found in the Sticky Swamp. Can you take her a few Pirhanoz for me?
description.troc: Bartering is common in the Islands. You can exchange goods for an item you desire. I'd like to exchange a banana for a coat rack. Do you think you can do that for me?
description.kilksk: I just received an emergency call from the Underwater Dome. The Atalants are extremely worried about the number of invading Kazkadines. Can you take your Dinoz there to clean it up? Make sure you don't get electrocuted.
description.kilang: Do you know the traditional dish: Eeloz with vinegar? It's delicious! Can you get some fresh Eeloz and vinegar and take them to my friend at Frish Port? It's a present!
description.bigpch: I'm a bit embarrassed. I promised the Underwater Dome Archsage that I would exterminate 150 Atlanteid Island monsters in ten days. Unfortunately I've broken my arm and can't really move. Can you kill thirty monsters for me? I'll take care of the others!
description.rally1: Take part in the Sardine Rally! Go to Frish Port as fast as possible!
description.rally2: Take part in the Fishes Rally! Go to Frish Port as quickly as possible!
description.rally3: Take part in the Sharks Rally! Go to the Coral Mines as quickly as possible!
description.rally4: Take part in the Whales Rally! Go to Lavapit and return as quickly as possible!
description.tour: The DinoLand Tour is the most famous race in all of DinoLand! Race round Dinoland in less than ten days! The first checkpoint is on Waikiki Island.
description.kswim: The Grumhel Jungle is a fascinating place! Here, take the korgons for example. They have adapted wonderfully to their environment! Did you know that they made their own flippers in order to be able to cross the Jumin river without difficulty? No? Here, I'm willing to offer you a pair if you bring me back some basic necessities...
description.rivals: While the Korgons from these parts of the Jungle are almost sociable, there are some in the South, on the outskirts of the Sinister Path who are otherwise less friendly. I think if you brought me proof of victory over those to the south, the korgons here would appreciate us much more!
description.kfood: There is somewhere in Grumhel a rare species of tree that the Korgons love: the Ashen Fikoïa! I don't know where you can find some, but I'll pay you well if you bring me some!
description.poison: The Ashy Fikoia you found will quickly become a strategic point for the Southern Korgons ... We have to react quickly! We will "booby-trap" some trees' branches in order to stop them from eating it ... we'll be the only ones who know which branches are dangerous ... ha ha!
description.init1: Yo... So, for the Strategy Guide, you have to translate it... to the Ashpouk ruins. You should be able.
description.init2: Hmmm, these Archelion merguez really pack a punch! Well now that I know you're competent, if you do me one more favor I'll give you my Strategy Guide. The Big All-Hot is an ideal environment for Archelions of all sizes. Wild, very dry and constantly erupting! But we have to stay away from them as long as we want to live, otherwise they'll eat us for supper. I want you to make me an Archelion scarecrow! It needs some Sharpened Claws.
description.burn: As you have probably noticed, this region is swarming with Flamelets. Even if their presence is necessary to complete the cosmic equilibrium, they have now over populated Dinoland and some need to be culled! We must hurry. Go to the Tunnel under the Branch passing alongside the crater. The place is swarming with them!
description.barbec: It seems a certain merguez seller in the Ashpouk Ruins uses a special combustible which caused the influx of flamelets. Something must be done! However, we can't stop this poor merchant from doing his job, we will need to find a more subtle solution. Start by collecting some ingredients: a dry branch, a Dorogon scale and a piece of yellow basalt. Mix these ingredients up and grind them into a powder, then throw it onto the barbecue!
description.joke: For many years, University Professor Eugene and I have had an on-going quarrel. In fact, we never agree on a subject, no matter what the subject is! Help me play a trick on this old curmydgeon. First of all I want you to find something with a pungent smell. I think Frish Port will be a good place to look...
description.defend: I saw swarms of monsters moving towards the mountains this morning. It looked like they were heading for the forges of the Big All-Hot. Go and protect them!
description.shipmt: Some time ago, I ordered a new powder reserve for my rituals from Grandpa Joe, but my package never arrived! Maybe this is because of the recent attack on the Forges, it must be lost somewhere. The package is extremely important, can you find it for me? It's very urgent!
description.sales: I sell little trinkets from time to time at the Dinotown market to make a little money. Unfortunately I'm really busy at the moment, do you think that you could go there for me and sell some souvenirs? I'll give you a nice percentage of the profits! You'll see, my souvenirs sell very well.
description.ritual: The Shamanic Congregation, where I learned my trade, wants me to perform a ritual each year to as a way of paying them back for all my training. Of course, I have better things to do than this stupid ritual! Can you take care of this for me? The instructions are in my mailbox.
description.hiero: I've heard that there are some hieroglyphics in the caverns to the west, en route to Grumhel Jungle. These hieroglyphics are very important for my mystical research! Go and copy them out for me. Be careful! To enter the caverns you will need to find something that will help you find your way back in the darkness!
description.pigeon: The recent discoveries in the caverns have provided me with an unexpected occasion to prove my theories to Professor Eugene! Imagine that, some ancient handwriting that talks of current events! We can't waste any time! Take this letter to him!
description.unmute: The scroll which has fallen on your head includes the following message: _« Find 1 measure of fresh free-flowing water, 1 measure of stagnant water, 1 measure of purified water and lastly 1 measure of boiling water. »_ You've barely finished reading the message before an empty small gourd falls from the tree and hits you on the head! Plunk!
description.orchid: A scroll dangles down from a branch. It reads: _« Go water the Orchid Child at the Edge of the Jungle »._ Something in the canopy throws you an empty gourd. Plunk!
description.licens: You see a scroll is attached to a root. It reads: _« Korgons and Bramble Eaters from the south are exceeding the wood cutting quota that I set in the Grumhel Jungle. Go and make sure they stick to the quota. »_
description.king: A message has been written on a small piece of cloth hooked on a branch: _« A few years ago we created a story about a King of the Jungle in order to keep tourists away. Go to the Haunted Hills and pretend to be the King of the Jungle by calling out.... »_
description.wishes: You read a message inscribed on a branch: _« Legend says that the South Falls have magic properties ... Go and throw a coin into the Mutant Falls. Make a wish that the population of Korgons and Bramble Eaters in the jungle will decrease.»_ A copper coin rolls along a branch and hits your foot.
description.newplt: A long piece of cloth is wrapped around the old tree, it reads: _« Our efforts to develop the forest near the Big All-Hot have recently been compromised by a huge rockfall near the Ashpouk Ruins. Take this jack and remove the plants and rocks. »_ A heavy iron jack suddenly falls on the ground next to you.
description.gshop: A wooden sign and a little white iron bucket are hanging on a branch: _« Drop some gold into the bucket to get your daily ration. »_
description.seqact: To enter the jungle, you must take the Sinister Path ... it's a dangerous road that leads north. Can you make sure it's safe?
description.toxic: I'm allergic to certain plants that are found in the jungle ... but I don't know which ones! Can you gather some suspicious-looking plants for me so I can carry out some tests?
description.map: A good map always helps. The only problem is there's no map available for the Grumhel Jungle! Can you head north and take some notes for me? The hills are located to the east, they'll provide you with the perfect viewpoint!
description.hucure: Vat's is nice from you ... I vink the Bonks from mutant valls can help me ... Take the blants you brought me and go to see them on my vehalf ... Sniff....
description.bckpck: Before starting my long and dangerous journey, there's one more thing I need, a good backpack. I lost mine when I was travelling through the Mutant Falls ... Can you find it for me?
description.rodriz: I need some Amnesiac Rice to recharge my magic cape. I've been told that it grows in the Sticky Swamp of the Atlanteid Islands. Can you bring me enough Rice to recharge my cape so I can become invisible again? Hurry up, it's really important!
description.rodlif: Three Dark Dinoz from Caushemesh are waiting for you at the Mutant Falls. Go and defeat them and then return to receive your reward ... take my advice, don't try to defeat them alone, your Dinoz could die!
description.skully1: Mouldeur a été touché par ma bonnédiction, alors que l'on faisait de vieux os ensemble, il m'a tout à coup oubliée et s'en est allé loin d'ici, le ruffian ! Il a sûrement dû donner des nouvelles à son neveu le ptit'joe… Va le voir et tiens moi au courant !
description.skully2: "Je t'attendrai sur le lieu de notre rencontre" Oh oh oh oh ! Comme c'est roooomantique mon Mouldeur chéri ! J'espère en tout cas qu'il m'attend encore là-bas ! Vite, rends toi dans ce magnifique lieu aux douces odeurs de nénuphars où nous nous sommes rencontrés, et ramène-moi mon amour !
description.skully3: Oh oh oh ! J'ai pensé à quelque chose de... problématique. Même si je retrouve Mouldeur, il va oublier à nouveau nos retrouvailles et repartir m'attendre quelque part. Il faut absolument que tu trouves une solution à ce problème avant d'aller voir Mouldeur. Va trouver cette chère Mademoiselle Bao, elle aura certainement une solution !
description.skully4: "Rejoins moi là où je t'ai déclaré ma flamme" Oh oh oh oh ! Mon Mouldeur a vraiment un coeur en oooor ! Je n'oublierai jamais ce lieu délicieux où il nous avait emmenés, alors que nos os étaient encore tous jeunes... Et ce moment où il m'a tendu une merguez bien grillée et m'a demandé de l'épouser !
description.skully5: Des "Crevettes au Napalm" ? Oh oh oh oh ! Quel doux souvenir que ce plat délicieux ! Bien, il va falloir que tu me rapportes un certain nombre d'ingrédients pour que je puisse préparer tout celà...
description.skully_end: Ta mission touche à sa fin... Apporte ce plat de crevettes au Napalm auprès de mon cher Mouldeur. Il reconnaitra ma cuisine et reviendra à moi ! Oh oh oh !
